style="position:absolute;top:3222px;left:3181.25px;letter-spacing:6.3px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[多年前，我曾經和一位出版業界的資深編輯聊天，她問我，將來]{#ANAKIN-15.xhtml#_idTextSpan505
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4556px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[遇到大空頭市場的時候，該怎麼投資呢？因為以她數10年的經驗告訴]{#ANAKIN-15.xhtml#_idTextSpan506
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5012px;left:0px;letter-spacing:20.89px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[我，每每到了股市大多頭尾聲的時候，財經投資類書籍會如雨後春筍]{#ANAKIN-15.xhtml#_idTextSpan507
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5468px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[般不斷地冒出來，然而真正崩盤之後，投資類書籍彷彿進入緘默期，]{#ANAKIN-15.xhtml#_idTextSpan508
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5924px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[沒有人能教你大空頭當中贏的方法。她知道我是在全球金融市場上征戰]{#ANAKIN-15.xhtml#_idTextSpan509
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6380px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.66px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[了20年，少數存活下來的真贏家，所以，她希望我寫出這麼一本書。]{#ANAKIN-15.xhtml#_idTextSpan510
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6836px;left:0px;letter-spacing:11.67px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[但是，我沒興趣寫空頭市場下操作建議的書，我認為不會熱賣，]{#ANAKIN-15.xhtml#_idTextSpan511
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7748px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[為什麼呢？因為往往只有當事情發生了，大家才會找解答，就像中毒]{#ANAKIN-15.xhtml#_idTextSpan512
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8204px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[之後才會求醫找解藥。人們普遍厭惡喊空、做空的人。我向來就是以]{#ANAKIN-15.xhtml#_idTextSpan513
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8660px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[法、把方向反過來做就可以賺錢？股市有一句老話：「漲時重勢，跌時]{#ANAKIN-16.xhtml#_idTextSpan520
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[重質。」要在空頭市場勝出的選股邏輯和操作策略，與多頭時期截然不]{#ANAKIN-16.xhtml#_idTextSpan521
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[同，若在空頭時期固執地繼續用多頭時的方法做股票，往往會導致慘]{#ANAKIN-16.xhtml#_idTextSpan522
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[賠的結果。《一個投機者的告白》的作者科斯托蘭尼說，往往需要經過]{#ANAKIN-16.xhtml#_idTextSpan523

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:20.25px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[了市場，後來雖然有新的戰友，但是2008年金融海嘯當中倖存下來的]{#ANAKIN-16.xhtml#_idTextSpan529
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:0px;letter-spacing:20.24px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[也幾乎沒幾位。金融市場就是這麼奧妙，每次的大空頭過後，就會有]{#ANAKIN-16.xhtml#_idTextSpan530
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[半數的投資人離開了這個市場，然後又有新臉孔加入，而這些新手往]{#ANAKIN-16.xhtml#_idTextSpan531
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[往不知道大空頭的可畏，而用天真而狂傲的態度在這個市場上遊走，]{#ANAKIN-16.xhtml#_idTextSpan532

style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[直到大空頭來襲，他們開始變得謙卑卻已經來不及了，通常又是一半]{#ANAKIN-16.xhtml#_idTextSpan533

style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:480px;letter-spacing:14.14px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[圖時，馬上會將大量資金匯入該國，透過炒作匯率或股市，在短]{#ANAKIN-27.xhtml#_idTextSpan764
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:480px;letter-spacing:14.14px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[期內獲取暴利，並且又迅速地匯出。]{#ANAKIN-27.xhtml#_idTextSpan765
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:480px;letter-spacing:10.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[熱錢的多寡，會視資金的成本，以及市場的投機貪婪風氣高]{#ANAKIN-27.xhtml#_idTextSpan766
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:919.37px;letter-spacing:14.13px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[低而變化，不會有一個絕對的數額，但若以目前（2017年）全世]{#ANAKIN-27.xhtml#_idTextSpan767
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:480px;letter-spacing:13.19px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[界多數國家仍維持在低利率、而股市很熱的環境下，這類國際熱]{#ANAKIN-27.xhtml#_idTextSpan768
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:480px;letter-spacing:14.14px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[錢的總和，加起來可能有5至10兆美元之多。這麼龐大的資金快]{#ANAKIN-27.xhtml#_idTextSpan769
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:8208px;left:480px;letter-spacing:17.27px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[速進出一個淺碟的市場，尤其對新興國家來說，衝擊會相當大。]{#ANAKIN-27.xhtml#_idTextSpan770
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:8664px;left:480px;letter-spacing:10.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[若要解析1997年亞洲金融風暴的關鍵成因，主要是因為當時不少]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan774
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:20.25px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[亞洲新興國家為了追逐高度經濟成長，各國政府紛紛張開雙手鬆綁法]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan775
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[規、歡迎外資進入投資，讓國際資金助長了經濟繁榮，但也同時埋下]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan776
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[了資產泡沫的地雷。]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan777
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[然而，致命的缺陷在於，這些國家長期實施「固定匯率」制度，也]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan778
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:13.37px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[就是說，該國貨幣兌換1美元的匯率幾乎是固定的，或者是被政府控制]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan779
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:17.35px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[在一個極小的波動範圍內遊走。為了維持穩定的匯率水準，這些國家]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan780
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[長期動用外匯存底來彌補逆差，導致國家的外匯存底減少、政府被迫]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan781
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[再度舉債而造成短期外債的增加。]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan782
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[倘若外資大舉抽離，由於資金流出量太大，而這些國家的外匯]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan783
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:30.65px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[儲備又不足以支應短期的匯出需求，結果就迎來了無可避免的貨幣貶]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan784
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[值。國際炒家們便是看準了當時幾個亞洲新興國家都有這個通病，認]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan785
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[為這些國家的資產泡沫]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan786
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:0px;letter-spacing:15.13px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[（包括股市泡沫、房地產泡沫、甚至堪稱經濟泡沫）]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan787
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:6404px;left:2304.3px;letter-spacing:12.38px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[已經]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan788
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:6640.58px;letter-spacing:15.82px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[走到了末期、難以為繼時，於是大舉做空該國的匯率，並透過國際媒]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan789
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[體發布負面消息以促使其他的外資撤離該國，因而從中賺取做空匯率]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan790
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的獲利。]{#ANAKIN-28.xhtml#_idTextSpan791
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[從大量放空泰銖開始，迫使泰國放棄維持已久的與美元掛鈎的固定匯]{#ANAKIN-29.xhtml#_idTextSpan802
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[率制度，改而採行自由浮動的匯率機制。因為這個改變，引發了泰國]{#ANAKIN-29.xhtml#_idTextSpan803
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[金融市場前所未有的危機，並蔓延到全亞洲，甚至副作用還擴散到俄]{#ANAKIN-29.xhtml#_idTextSpan804
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[羅斯，在1998年造成其債務違約......]{#ANAKIN-29.xhtml#_idTextSpan805
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:14.06px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[整個過程都在安納金的眼中，親眼目睹、親身經歷。也因此，讓]{#ANAKIN-29.xhtml#_idTextSpan806
.CharOverride-24

]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan989 .CharOverride-8

.CharOverride-8
style="position:absolute;top:28.32px;left:682px;letter-spacing:7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 112.11px;-webkit-transform:matrix(1,0,0,0.96,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 112.11px;transform:matrix(1,0,0,0.96,0,0);"}

::: {#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idContainer406 .基本文字框}
::: {style="width:7086.61px;height:8900.79px;position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 0%; -webkit-transform: translate(0px,4.3px) rotate(0deg) scale(0.05);transform-origin: 0% 0%; transform: translate(0px,4.3px) rotate(0deg) scale(0.05);"}
[區，許多悲劇都是在這段期間發生的，此書暫不多談，將來若有完整的]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan991
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[《安納金傳》著作獨立問世時，會再詳述。]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan992
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[在這一段大空頭市場當中，安納金回到了校園就讀碩士班。就在]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan993
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[這段期間，安納金第一次接觸到技術分析、籌碼分析。]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan994
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[然而，第一次的接觸，並不美妙，因為習慣於總體經濟宏觀分析]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan995
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的安納金，對於技術派操作者的許多論點，並不以為然，認為忽多忽]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan996
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[空的操作方式是荒謬、自己不能認同的，於是有不小的排斥感，甚至為]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan997
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.66px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[了捍衛自己對於總體經濟分析的判斷與邏輯，與其他只看技術面的人產]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan998
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.66px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[生了衝突與爭執。]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan999
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:12.1px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[所幸，安納金的指導教授，是台灣最早期的第一批基金經理人，]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan1000
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[在30多年前的那個時代，全台灣的基金經理人沒有幾位，每一位都掌]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan1001
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:0px;letter-spacing:20.89px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[管數10億的資金，是所有上市櫃公司眼中的重量級買家、最穩定的大]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan1002
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:0px;letter-spacing:20.89px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[股東，也是公司派和市場派急欲討好的對象，而在投資人心中則是被]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan1003
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[視為神聖般的職位，可以呼風喚雨、動見觀瞻。]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan1004
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[安納金的指導教授，就是在基金經理人的實務世界中看透了市場]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan1005
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8208px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的運作，或許覺得不夠挑戰性，於是轉往學界、投身教育，尋求另一]{#ANAKIN-38.xhtml#_idTextSpan1006
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8664px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}
:::

[按照安納金當時的分析判斷能力，每天開盤買進的5檔股票，平均]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1090
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:17.16px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[會有3檔漲停板、1檔小漲，僅會有1檔小跌或平盤。也因為有這麼高]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1091
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:24.44px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的平均勝率與報酬率，讓安納金開始著迷於當沖交易。]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1092
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[當沖交易最迷人之處，就是幾乎不需要使用到本金，只要確保當]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1093
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[天融資買進的標的可以在收盤前全部用融券沖銷掉，那麼當天只是結]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1094
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[算一來一回的損益，本金還是本金，這彷彿是一個「無本生意」，尤其]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1095
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[在這麼準的選股能力下，愈是做得積極，就愈是賺得過癮；愈是高持]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1096
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.44px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[股比例，就愈能夠充分掌握一天能夠交易的效率，創造最大化的獲利。]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1097
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.66px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[因此，使用「槓桿」來放大操作部位，成了這個局勢下最好的策略。]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1098
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:12.1px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[於是每天一早，安納金就會透過融資的槓桿，把持股拉高到]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1099
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:40.29px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[200％以上，甚至400％（超買無所謂，反正只要在收盤前沖銷掉就好]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1100
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:19.63px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[了）。在這樣的高槓桿當沖交易之下，可想而知，安納金的績效是非常]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1101
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[驚人的數字，市場上沒有任何一檔基金的績效可以相比，也因此，讓]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1102
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[安納金自認為「喊水會結凍」、無人能敵，然而也因為這種年少輕狂、]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1103
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[不可一世的心理，種下了2008年瀕臨破產邊緣的禍根。]{#ANAKIN-43.xhtml#_idTextSpan1104
.CharOverride-24

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[量就是固定的，至於股價要漲要跌，就要看籌碼的需求來決定。]{#ANAKIN-44.xhtml#_idTextSpan1130

.CharOverride-24

.CharOverride-24

.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:932px;left:3960.76px;letter-spacing:13.71px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[時，不到1天）]{#ANAKIN-45.xhtml#_idTextSpan1141
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:1388px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.99px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[所以公司的基本面根本尚未有什麼改變，因此，股價的變]{#ANAKIN-45.xhtml#_idTextSpan1142
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:1242.6px;letter-spacing:19.19px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[化就幾乎決定於籌碼的變化，而技術面可以用來觀察與驗證這個變化]{#ANAKIN-45.xhtml#_idTextSpan1143
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[是否正確，以及變化的強度高低。]{#ANAKIN-45.xhtml#_idTextSpan1144
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[另一個重要的籌碼分析方法，則是透過「成交量的解析」。一般投]{#ANAKIN-45.xhtml#_idTextSpan1145
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:13.37px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[資人會看成交量的大小，每一天、每一檔股票就是一個成交量，這是]{#ANAKIN-45.xhtml#_idTextSpan1146
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[很籠統的看法。安納金看的則是「成交量的品質」，也就是分析單一個]{#ANAKIN-45.xhtml#_idTextSpan1147
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[股當天成交的買家分布狀況、賣家的分布狀況。]{#ANAKIN-45.xhtml#_idTextSpan1148
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[如果買家很集中、賣家很分散，那麼等於是籌碼變得更集中]{#ANAKIN-45.xhtml#_idTextSpan1149
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:17.77px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[（例如]{#ANAKIN-45.xhtml#_idTextSpan1150
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:5492px;left:6528.92px;letter-spacing:14.19px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[大單買進，而散戶零星的籌碼被大戶吸納了）]{#ANAKIN-45.xhtml#_idTextSpan1151

.CharOverride-24

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.47px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[（例如主力出貨會是大單敲出，而眾多散戶承接，就會]{#ANAKIN-45.xhtml#_idTextSpan1154

[在當時]{#ANAKIN-45.xhtml#_idTextSpan1157 .CharOverride-24

[在多頭市場，追蹤個股的籌碼、加以技術面分析的判斷，是很容]{#ANAKIN-46.xhtml#_idTextSpan1172
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[易獲利的，甚至財富翻上好幾倍都有可能。不過，這個在多頭市場非]{#ANAKIN-46.xhtml#_idTextSpan1173
.CharOverride-24

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:0px;letter-spacing:19.05px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[戶的總市值還能創下了歷史新高。]{#ANAKIN-46.xhtml#_idTextSpan1180
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

.CharOverride-24

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[股的成交量是相對較小的，當主力大戶]{#ANAKIN-46.xhtml#_idTextSpan1183
.CharOverride-24

[這段期間伴隨的全球景氣快速滑落、收縮，電子業「砍單」和「退]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1213
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:13.37px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[單」]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1214
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:15.85px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[（指的是縮減或取消原本已經下的訂單）]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1215
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:476px;left:462.27px;letter-spacing:12.97px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[變得普遍，許多產業陸續面臨困]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1216
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:3866.26px;letter-spacing:15.9px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[境，從部分的小型廠商開始出現財務危機、甚至惡性倒閉，慢慢牽連]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1217
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[到一些中大型公司也陷入財務吃緊，股價頻頻破底。]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1218
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[尤其到了股市跌勢的末期，大盤成交量萎縮到只剩下3、400億]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1219
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:28.54px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[元的時候，小型股完全沒有買盤，融資斷頭賣壓湧現，往往連續鎖跌]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1220
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[停。若是像台積電、鴻海、台塑、國泰金這些重量級的大公司，普遍]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1221
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[跌到距離公司淨值1倍到1.5倍的時候，還有長線價值投資者的強勁買]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1222
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:20.24px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[盤作為支撐；然而若是小型股的話，可能跌到股價淨值比只剩下0.5倍]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1223
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[都是很常見的。]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1224
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[因為當市場極度悲觀時，投資人會擔心公司可能要倒閉、清算資]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1225
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[產時那些廠房設備也不值錢，而且清算過程很冗長，要很久之後才能]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1226
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[拿到錢，偏偏大家當下就缺錢了，因此寧可認賠殺出、馬上變現。就]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1227
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[算公司不倒閉，投資人也擔心因為公司嚴重虧損，所以未來它的淨值]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1228
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[會大幅下降。這就是為什麼在大空頭下，小公司的股票價格有可能會]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1229
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[跌到只剩下它淨值的一半。]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1230
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[儘管上市櫃公司在大空頭當中，常常因為股價的腰斬再腰斬，出]{#ANAKIN-48.xhtml#_idTextSpan1231
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8664px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}
:::

]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1235 .CharOverride-25

::: {style="width:7086.61px;height:8900.79px;position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 0%; -webkit-transform: translate(0px,4.3px) rotate(0deg) scale(0.05);transform-origin: 0% 0%; transform: translate(0px,4.3px) rotate(0deg) scale(0.05);"}
[面公開信心喊話，然而事實證明：營收和獲利並無法因為信心喊話而]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1238
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[回升，基本面的惡化通常是在股價已經大跌過後，才能夠得到佐證。]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1239
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[「買回庫藏股」比起「口水護盤」更實在的多，畢竟是上市櫃公司真]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1240
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:5.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的要拿出錢來在市場上買回自家股票，多少會有一些籌碼上的支撐效]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1241
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[果]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1242
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:17.93px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[（如前一節所述，籌碼從較多凌亂的散戶手中回流到公司派，也就是由一個大的買]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1243
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:2300px;left:233.17px;letter-spacing:14.63px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[方吃下，籌碼因而會變得相對集中，股價較容易上漲）]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1244
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:2756px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[。]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1245
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:4551.12px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[但是，上市櫃公司買回庫藏股並不是穩賺不賠的，有不少案例顯]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1246
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[示，公司買回庫藏股的時機不對，結果股價後續再腰斬的也是所在多]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1247
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[有。或者，股價是在經過了一段很長的時間後，才慢慢回升，這會使]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1248
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[得那些「看到公司買回庫藏股」的消息就跟著買進的散戶，卻沒有能力]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1249
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[撐過那一段谷底，中途就認賠殺出了。]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1250
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[在大空頭當中，不只是公司派的動作或說出來的話不能盡信，連]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1251
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[原本在多頭市場上像是股神般準確的專家們，在空頭市場中也一一慘]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1252
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[賠，被原本相信他們的人罵得臭頭，因而銷聲匿跡。]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1253
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[安納金在2004年至2007年的大多頭環境當中，因為朋友的推薦，]{#ANAKIN-49.xhtml#_idTextSpan1254
.CharOverride-24

::: {#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idContainer664 .基本文字框}
::: {style="width:7086.61px;height:8900.79px;position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 0%; -webkit-transform: translate(0px,4.3px) rotate(0deg) scale(0.05);transform-origin: 0% 0%; transform: translate(0px,4.3px) rotate(0deg) scale(0.05);"}
[然而，也因為在A波、B波的過程，是屬於個股輪跌、個股輪流反]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1410
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:20.95px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[彈的，這會讓老手們很容易在此打敗指數，因為基本上指數已經處在]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1411
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[緩跌的趨勢當中，而他們的帳戶總值仍繼續增長，基於這種優勢，以]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1412
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[及充足的自信與自傲，會讓他們繼續把全部的資金放在股市中大手筆]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1413
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的操作，直到大盤指數B波反彈的結束，C波的到來。
]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1414 .CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:15.84px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[股市傷人的通常不是A波，股市老手都是死在C波。因為不同於]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1415
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:29.56px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[A波的輪流下跌、輪流反彈，C波是各大類股全面齊跌的，很少有股]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1416
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:28.92px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[票可以逆勢抗跌。因為通常來到C波的時候，基本面已經惡化到讓市]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1417
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:25.26px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[場上所有的投資人，都會明顯感受到景氣的嚴重衰退，包括公司的裁]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1418
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[員、減薪等等壞消息滿天飛，股市投資人若有在上班領薪水的，會害]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1419
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[怕蠟燭兩頭燒]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1420
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:0px;letter-spacing:18.04px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[（收入變少，而投資又在虧損）]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1421
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:5036px;left:1399.65px;letter-spacing:14.76px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[，沒在上班的人更因為沒有穩]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1422
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:4071.71px;letter-spacing:17.92px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[定的收入來源，更不敢把自己的退休老本虧掉，因而更是擔憂害怕。]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1423
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[因此，在C波下跌勢頭中的投資人，心情普遍有如驚弓之鳥，股]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1424
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:25.63px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[價若跌，速度很快、又急又猛，稍微一個不留意，就是跑不掉的跌停]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1425
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[板。有使用融資的投資人，大多很快就會接到融資追繳令，不補保證]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1426
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[金就會被斷頭，「融資斷頭令，萬箭齊發」就是這個階段很容易看到的]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1427
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[每日財經新聞頭條。老手在這個階段，被整體多數投資人的恐慌、亂]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1428
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8208px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[賣股票而拖累，加上有些主力作手用的是金主的錢在操作，當金主看]{#ANAKIN-55.xhtml#_idTextSpan1429
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8664px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}
:::

::: {style="width:7086.61px;height:8900.79px;position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 0%; -webkit-transform: translate(0px,4.3px) rotate(0deg) scale(0.05);transform-origin: 0% 0%; transform: translate(0px,4.3px) rotate(0deg) scale(0.05);"}
[到有愈來愈多的操盤手虧損嚴重，於是要收回資金，迫使不少操盤手]{#ANAKIN-56.xhtml#_idTextSpan1433
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[要賣股求現，結果就是進一步的加重了股市的跌幅。]{#ANAKIN-56.xhtml#_idTextSpan1434
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[C波就是「多殺多」的環境，原本的做多者因為急於離開市場而相]{#ANAKIN-56.xhtml#_idTextSpan1435
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:17.16px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[互踩踏，形成人踩死人的慘況。事實上，在2008年的金融海嘯中，即]{#ANAKIN-56.xhtml#_idTextSpan1436
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:20.24px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[便許多主力和老手也都相繼慘賠、被迫離開市場，就連市場上幾位知]{#ANAKIN-56.xhtml#_idTextSpan1437
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[名的大金主也無法倖免。]{#ANAKIN-56.xhtml#_idTextSpan1438

[這次全球經濟的景氣觸底，是在2009年8月才被判定，谷底出現]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1485
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:23.92px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[在2009年第2季，因此，美股領先了美國景氣3至6個月見底，而台股]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1486
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:22.96px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[又領先了美股3個多月先見底。此時，走出破產負債邊緣的安納金，因]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1487
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:0px;letter-spacing:17.35px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[為熟悉技術面和籌碼面，因此早在2009年3月就已經重新回到市場、]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1488
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:23.68px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[強力做多股市。]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1489
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[截至2009年底，結算安納金全年的績效表現，是563％，不用融]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1490
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:23.15px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[資、沒有槓桿，全憑選股能力和波段操作的實力。因此安納金有一句]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1491
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[名言：「大空頭市場中，你損失的是財富，但不能損失你的志氣，而你]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1492
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[要獲得的是新的能力。」其中，「志氣」就是讓安納金在多數投資人還]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1493
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[在療傷止痛、誓言永遠不再進入股市的時候，最早回到股市、從底部]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1494
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[買起的堅強勇氣；「獲得新的能力」則是看透股市中貪婪和恐懼的盛衰]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1495
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[循環道理、尋找到投資聖杯，那種超乎人性的紀律。]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1496
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[雖然2009年全球股市強勁反彈，然而經濟並沒有顯著的轉好，這]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1497
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:20.25px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[使得美國聯準會將聯邦基金利率降到有史以來最低的零利率之後，在]{#ANAKIN-59.xhtml#_idTextSpan1498
.CharOverride-24

.羅馬字縮緊 .CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:19.05px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[底，然而歐洲經濟並沒有從衰退中走出來，包括：義大利、西班牙、]{#ANAKIN-60.xhtml#_idTextSpan1516
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[葡萄牙、希臘、愛爾蘭在內的5個國家，此時瀕臨財政危機，被稱之為]{#ANAKIN-60.xhtml#_idTextSpan1517
.CharOverride-24

.CharOverride-24

.CharOverride-47

.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:480px;letter-spacing:14.14px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[賣規定範圍內，對方交易所上市的股票。這為中國內地的A股市]{#ANAKIN-62.xhtml#_idTextSpan1568

.CharOverride-47

.羅馬字縮緊 .CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:480px;letter-spacing:2.38px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[能夠進行開戶與買賣。也或者，投資人必須間接透過擁有QFII及]{#ANAKIN-62.xhtml#_idTextSpan1572
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:480px;letter-spacing:13.19px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[RQFII額度的共同基金或ETF進行A股的投資。]{#ANAKIN-62.xhtml#_idTextSpan1573

[在2015年6月10日，MSCI宣布「暫不將A股納入其相關指數成]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1583
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:32.74px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[分」的聲明之前，安納金早在6月8日時，就將A股ETF、以及2倍做多]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1584
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:22.96px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[槓桿型ETF全數出清，並少量買進A股反向的ETF，布局空頭部位。]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1585
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:0px;letter-spacing:30.55px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[做出這個判斷的主因，不在於A股納入MSCI指數與否，而是發現中國]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1586
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:23.68px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[股市的投資人，顯然已經貪婪到了極點，安納金看到多頭行情已經走]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1587
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[到了崩潰的邊緣。]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1588
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[事實上，許多東南亞國家的股市從2015年3月就見到高點、開始]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1589
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:23.92px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[起跌。台股是在2015年4月28日創下10014點的波段新高後起跌、美]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1590
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:24.79px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[股則是在2015年5月20日見到高點後開始起跌，中國內地的股民們只]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1591
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:22.96px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[是後知後覺。]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1592
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[中國股市從2015年6月15日周一大盤指數的一根長黑K線，為空]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1593
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:26.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[頭揭開了序幕。由於中國股市自2014年8月以來的上漲，到了2015年]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1594
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:0px;letter-spacing:22.29px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的上半年，幾乎是用「爆量噴出」來形容，而多空是相生的，怎麼飆漲]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1595
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[上去的，就會怎麼暴跌下來。上證指數從5178點的高點起跌，在很短]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1596
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:20.24px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的時間內，就來到了4000點左右的半年線，相對於其他較早起跌的國]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1597
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:0px;letter-spacing:20.24px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[家股市，可以說中國股市的下跌是後發先至，率先殺到了半年線支撐]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1598
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[區，而在4000點附近出現巨幅的震盪。]{#ANAKIN-63.xhtml#_idTextSpan1599
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8208px;left:0px;letter-spacing:14.18px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[當上證指數來到4000點的半年線保衛戰時，是一個沒有趨勢方]{#ANAKIN-64.xhtml#_idTextSpan1603
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:28.54px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[向、快速上沖下洗的過程，無論做多或做空，都很難獲利。倒是安納]{#ANAKIN-64.xhtml#_idTextSpan1604
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[金從這個環境中，體認到了「盤前掛單」的好處，因為如果你看著盤中]{#ANAKIN-64.xhtml#_idTextSpan1605
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的急漲去追買，往往很快被殺下來、馬上虧損；如果你看到急跌而殺]{#ANAKIN-64.xhtml#_idTextSpan1606
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[出或者做空，結果莫名其妙的強勁反彈、你被迫又要回頭追買。不太]{#ANAKIN-64.xhtml#_idTextSpan1607
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[可能等市場給你方向後你才開始下單，因為市場根本就沒有方向！]{#ANAKIN-64.xhtml#_idTextSpan1608
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[盤前掛單的好處，就是紀律，以及冷靜。以當時的中國股市為]{#ANAKIN-64.xhtml#_idTextSpan1609
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:30.65px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[例，每天上下震盪，震幅大概是正負2％到3％，因此，可以在開盤前]{#ANAKIN-64.xhtml#_idTextSpan1610
.CharOverride-24

[沒有人看得到了。]{#ANAKIN-70.xhtml#_idTextSpan1732 .CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[安納金理解，在沒有經過大空頭市場的洗禮之前，是不太可能找]{#ANAKIN-70.xhtml#_idTextSpan1733
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[到自己投資的聖杯，《一個投機者的告白》的作者科斯托蘭尼說，往往]{#ANAKIN-70.xhtml#_idTextSpan1734
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[需要經過2次的破產，才能夠成就一位偉大的投機家。]{#ANAKIN-70.xhtml#_idTextSpan1735
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.04px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[Level ]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1937 .CharOverride-6
style="position:absolute;top:174.33px;left:484.56px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 160.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 160.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[1]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1938
.CharOverride-6
style="position:absolute;top:174.33px;left:1072.56px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 160.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 160.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[追尋厲害的「老師」和「戰友」]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1939
.CharOverride-31
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:480px;letter-spacing:18.75px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 200.20px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 200.20px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[在這個階段的新手們，通常會有一段不短的時間，熱衷跟著某一]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1940
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[位厲害的老師或前輩操作，而且有一群同好的戰友，一起接收相同的]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1941
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[資訊、一起進出、一起賺賠。]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1942
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[由於自己尚未具備分析、判斷行情的能力，也沒有研究產業及選]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1943
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[股的能力，所以多半的投資決定都是跟隨老師或戰友，偶爾自己試著]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1944
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[獨立做做看，不過以失敗居多，所以只好選擇相信比自己更厲害的人]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1945
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[並從中學習經驗和判斷能力。]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1946
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[然而金融市場的現實是：在不同的環境下，適合的交易策略或投]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1947
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[資風格必會有所不同。往往每過一段時間，市場不再有利於你原本的]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1948
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[操作方法或投資策略時，就會出現意外的大虧，於是你會失望，然後]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1949
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[開始尋找下一個值得跟隨的老師，並且產生新的戰友。]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1950
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[有很多投資人會在這個階段無窮的輪迴，而逃不開散戶的宿命，]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1951
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[但終究沒有找到一個能夠「穩定獲利」的方法。]{#ANAKIN-79.xhtml#_idTextSpan1952
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8208px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[．．．]{#ANAKIN-80.xhtml#_idTextSpan1958 .CharOverride-8
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:3327.22px;letter-spacing:10.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 112.11px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 112.11px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[通常剛進入市場不久的新手，急切於從股市當中獲利，而看]{#ANAKIN-80.xhtml#_idTextSpan1959
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:919.37px;letter-spacing:14.13px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[到一個大賺的方法，就會完全的投入、甚至迷上，直到行情轉變]{#ANAKIN-80.xhtml#_idTextSpan1960
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:480px;letter-spacing:14.14px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[成對這樣的投資方法不利的時候，便會慘賠出場、失望透頂、由]{#ANAKIN-80.xhtml#_idTextSpan1961
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:480px;letter-spacing:14.14px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[愛生恨。]{#ANAKIN-80.xhtml#_idTextSpan1962
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:480px;letter-spacing:10.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[實際上不是這些老師或前輩的問題，而是在多空循環的不同]{#ANAKIN-80.xhtml#_idTextSpan1963
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:919.37px;letter-spacing:14.13px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[階段，主流的類股不同，盤面的波動和漲跌特性也截然不同，不]{#ANAKIN-80.xhtml#_idTextSpan1964
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:480px;letter-spacing:14.14px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[可能有一套方法可以同時在多頭市場或空頭市場的每一個階段都]{#ANAKIN-80.xhtml#_idTextSpan1965
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:480px;letter-spacing:14.14px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[勝出，因此，過度著迷之後的失望透頂，是無可避免的。]{#ANAKIN-80.xhtml#_idTextSpan1966
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:480px;letter-spacing:10.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[唯有認清「市場本身才是最值得尊敬的，人在市場中都是渺]{#ANAKIN-80.xhtml#_idTextSpan1967
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:919.37px;letter-spacing:14.13px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[小的」，如此才能讓你擺脫對「人」的依賴，而將重心放在研究「市]{#ANAKIN-80.xhtml#_idTextSpan1968
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:480px;letter-spacing:-0.81px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[場」上面，也才能順利走出第1個階段。]{#ANAKIN-80.xhtml#_idTextSpan1969
.CharOverride-47
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:480px;letter-spacing:10.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 168.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

.CharOverride-24

style="position:absolute;top:952px;left:1281.83px;letter-spacing:16px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 256.25px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 256.25px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[金融市場是由眾多投資人所構成的，我們必須要理解一件事：人]{#ANAKIN-96.xhtml#_idTextSpan2370
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[類既然是生活在三度空間的生物，那麼你就絕對不能用二度空間的思]{#ANAKIN-96.xhtml#_idTextSpan2371
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[維去分析金融市場，一定會出錯。例如2016年的台股，不少人被多空]{#ANAKIN-96.xhtml#_idTextSpan2372

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:6.35px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[只是其中份量很輕的一環，自然就可以判斷何時該進場、何時該看看就]{#ANAKIN-96.xhtml#_idTextSpan2374

style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[婪、恐懼等心理因素所困，而做空者多半還比較理性，因為做空者較]{#ANAKIN-103.xhtml#_idTextSpan2593
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[在意「什麼價位算是合理」、「什麼價位已經超漲而不合理」。]{#ANAKIN-103.xhtml#_idTextSpan2594
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[通常，當做多者拼命在做夢的時候，做空者已在佈局空單；當做]{#ANAKIN-103.xhtml#_idTextSpan2595

[我曾經在部落格寫過，「股市是三分天下」，指的是永遠會有做空]{#ANAKIN-104.xhtml#_idTextSpan2602
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:13.37px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的人存在，也永遠會有做多的投機者和做多的投資者存在。如果市場]{#ANAKIN-104.xhtml#_idTextSpan2603
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[上少了這3種人的任何一種，要嘛不是崩盤，不然就會是一灘死水。]{#ANAKIN-104.xhtml#_idTextSpan2604
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[中國官方在2015年8月的股災之後，幾乎把做空者趕盡殺絕，]{#ANAKIN-104.xhtml#_idTextSpan2605
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:32.33px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[也幾乎廢了股指期貨市場。然而，沒有做空者，成交量萎縮如一灘死]{#ANAKIN-104.xhtml#_idTextSpan2606
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[水，至今已經接近2年了]{#ANAKIN-104.xhtml#_idTextSpan2607
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.71px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[（本書於2017年出版）]{#ANAKIN-104.xhtml#_idTextSpan2608
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:3668px;left:2443.92px;letter-spacing:9.47px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[，當全球多數股市已經大幅]{#ANAKIN-104.xhtml#_idTextSpan2609
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:4319.3px;letter-spacing:16.69px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[上漲甚至創下新高的同時，唯有中國A股還在地板附近徘徊。]{#ANAKIN-104.xhtml#_idTextSpan2610
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[做空者是穩定股市的一股力量，是「未來」確定的買家，且讓股市]{#ANAKIN-104.xhtml#_idTextSpan2611
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:13.37px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[保有自然循環的調節機制。失去空頭力量，股市反而遭殃。]{#ANAKIN-104.xhtml#_idTextSpan2612

.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:932px;left:1464.61px;letter-spacing:13.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[教你如何投機致富。]{#ANAKIN-106.xhtml#_idTextSpan2657
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:2059.96px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[許多人對投資有不好的經驗，或者是曾經灰心的離場，其實最大]{#ANAKIN-106.xhtml#_idTextSpan2658
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的問題，有可能就出在你把「投資」和「投機」的觀念混淆了。許多網路]{#ANAKIN-106.xhtml#_idTextSpan2659
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:6.49px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[上談論的股市操作方法和看法，是跟「短期投機」有關的，但卻被你誤]{#ANAKIN-106.xhtml#_idTextSpan2660
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[用到投資上；反之，若是把「投資的心法」拿來用在短期投機上，你也]{#ANAKIN-106.xhtml#_idTextSpan2661
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[會因為頻頻停損而被迫出局。]{#ANAKIN-106.xhtml#_idTextSpan2662
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[金融市場上存在著許多善意的謊言，也讓許多人因此付出慘痛]{#ANAKIN-106.xhtml#_idTextSpan2663
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:30.65px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的代價。為什麼市場上普遍不說真話呢？因為人人都有追求財富的自]{#ANAKIN-106.xhtml#_idTextSpan2664
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[由，沒有人應該要剝奪別人的這個夢想，但這個夢想一旦被利用，就]{#ANAKIN-106.xhtml#_idTextSpan2665
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[害了太多投資人受「投機心理」的驅使而損失慘重。]{#ANAKIN-106.xhtml#_idTextSpan2666
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[台灣有許多心地善良的投資人，只是因為有穩定的工作和收入，]{#ANAKIN-106.xhtml#_idTextSpan2667
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[所以讓投機的損失變得只是不嚴重危害到家庭或生活罷了。即便如]{#ANAKIN-106.xhtml#_idTextSpan2668
.CharOverride-24
