[杯的人，並不會把預測當作是最重要的一件事。雖然多數人會以為「準]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3026
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[確的預測」才是獲利最關鍵的因素，但或許就是因為市場上很少有人可]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3027
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[以持續地做出準確的預測，因而對於預測準確這件事情產生了一種莫]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3028
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[名的憧憬、一種想得到卻從來得不到的渴望。]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3029
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[這個心結，就好比我們在年輕的時候，普遍都會希望遇到一位「完]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3030
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:13.37px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[美情人」，若是能夠找到一位完美情人，成為一生的伴侶，那麼就會幸]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3031
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[福快樂一輩子。然而，當我們到了6、70歲的高齡時，再回頭看看自]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3032
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:24.44px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[己年輕時的這種天真想法，就會覺得很可笑，因為實際上「能否遇到完]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3033
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[美的情人」，並不是我們此生能不能幸福快樂的重點，事實上是：幸福]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3034
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[來自於無論遇到誰，你都能夠建立正確的心態、合適的相處之道，並]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3035
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[認清彼此的缺陷，一同成長，讓彼此變得更好。如果你沒有認清這個]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3036
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[事實，那麼就可能耗費了一生在追尋、在等待，盲目地蹉跎時間而終]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3037
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[究沒能找到你想要的幸福。]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3038
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[在投資的領域也是一樣，如果你可以先認清這個事實：金融市場]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3039
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[當中的贏家，並不是靠完美的預測而致富，那麼就算你還沒有找到投]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3040
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[資聖杯，至少你已經比別人更接近聖杯的所在地。]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3041
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[聖杯，有很多種不同的樣貌，因為它是因人而異的，每個人的性]{#ANAKIN-121.xhtml#_idTextSpan3042
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8664px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[己的缺陷，從實戰中累積經驗、累積智慧之後，人人都有可能因為透]{#ANAKIN-122.xhtml#_idTextSpan3049
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[過這樣自我改進的過程，最終找到適合自己的聖杯。]{#ANAKIN-122.xhtml#_idTextSpan3050
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[對於我曾經推薦過的幾位投資]{#ANAKIN-122.xhtml#_idTextSpan3051
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:11px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[（投機）]{#ANAKIN-122.xhtml#_idTextSpan3052
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:2756px;left:3413.53px;letter-spacing:9px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[界的大師來說，他們都找到了]{#ANAKIN-122.xhtml#_idTextSpan3053
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:4154.42px;letter-spacing:11.43px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[屬於自己的聖杯，台灣市場上也曾經出現過好幾位投資贏家或財經部]{#ANAKIN-122.xhtml#_idTextSpan3054
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[落客，他們都各自擁有一套投資或交易「贏的方法」，而且長期來說，]{#ANAKIN-122.xhtml#_idTextSpan3055
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[被驗證為能夠在不同的市場環境當中，得到相對穩定的獲利，因此就]{#ANAKIN-122.xhtml#_idTextSpan3056
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[算他們現在還未能完全達到財富自由，但是只要時間足夠，他們達到]{#ANAKIN-122.xhtml#_idTextSpan3057
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[財富自由只是早晚的事情。但是請一定要記住：投資或投機的聖杯「無]{#ANAKIN-122.xhtml#_idTextSpan3058
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[法被完全複製」，你只能參考贏家們的做法、去進行調整，而發展出真]{#ANAKIN-122.xhtml#_idTextSpan3059
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[正適合自己的一套方法。你找到的聖杯，也只有你可以完全的合用，]{#ANAKIN-122.xhtml#_idTextSpan3060
.CharOverride-24

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[投資哲學以及操作方法。而我個人經過長達20年的親身觀察和實證之]{#ANAKIN-143.xhtml#_idTextSpan3618

.CharOverride-31
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:480px;letter-spacing:18.75px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 200.20px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 200.20px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[索羅斯在1978年出版的《金融煉金術》中強調，市場並不是像教]{#ANAKIN-143.xhtml#_idTextSpan3622
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:20.25px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[科書所講的那樣理性和具有效率性，而是具有高度的不確定性和反射]{#ANAKIN-143.xhtml#_idTextSpan3623
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[性，這會帶來泡沫和市場的崩潰。他提出「反射理論」來解釋金融市]{#ANAKIN-143.xhtml#_idTextSpan3624
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[場的運作模式：金融市場中參與者的行為，包括了「認知功能」，以及]{#ANAKIN-143.xhtml#_idTextSpan3625
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[「參與功能」。在認知功能當中，具有思考能力的參與者試圖理解他所]{#ANAKIN-143.xhtml#_idTextSpan3626
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[參與的市場環境；另一方面，參與者參與到他們所理解的市場環境、]{#ANAKIN-143.xhtml#_idTextSpan3627
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[進行交易，就稱為參與功能。]{#ANAKIN-143.xhtml#_idTextSpan3628
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[索羅斯用數學函數來解釋這2種不同功能之間的關係，以及交互作]{#ANAKIN-143.xhtml#_idTextSpan3629
.CharOverride-24

[用：他分別把上述2種功能以函數來表示，在「認知函數」中，參與者]{#ANAKIN-144.xhtml#_idTextSpan3633
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;letter-spacing:17.35px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[所認知的「市場環境」是自變數；而在「參與函數」中，參與者的「認知]{#ANAKIN-144.xhtml#_idTextSpan3634
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:6.49px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[思維」是自變數。這兩個函數同時發揮作用，相互影響，一個函數的自]{#ANAKIN-144.xhtml#_idTextSpan3635
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[變數是另一個函數的因變數，這樣將致使「不再產生確定的結果」。由]{#ANAKIN-144.xhtml#_idTextSpan3636
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[於「市場環境」和「認知思維」兩者，均為因變數，所以，一個初始變化]{#ANAKIN-144.xhtml#_idTextSpan3637
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:6.49px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[會同時引起市場環境和參與者思維的進一步變化，而這兩個相互參照]{#ANAKIN-144.xhtml#_idTextSpan3638
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的函數將不可能產生均衡點，而只是產生一個無限變動的過程，索羅]{#ANAKIN-144.xhtml#_idTextSpan3639
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[斯稱這種相互作用為「反射性」。]{#ANAKIN-144.xhtml#_idTextSpan3640
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[由於市場上的投資人對於金融市場環境的認知和預測，普遍都是]{#ANAKIN-144.xhtml#_idTextSpan3641
.CharOverride-24

[投資者的紀律：判斷股票的「合理價值」與「買進時機」]{#ANAKIN-147.xhtml#_idTextSpan3704
.CharOverride-31
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:480px;letter-spacing:18.75px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 200.20px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 200.20px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[對投資者來說，「紀律」主要是巴菲特所說的「內在價值」]{#ANAKIN-147.xhtml#_idTextSpan3705
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:4.48px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[（判斷該不]{#ANAKIN-147.xhtml#_idTextSpan3706
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:932px;left:6190.25px;letter-spacing:5.63px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[該買進）]{#ANAKIN-147.xhtml#_idTextSpan3707
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:1388px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[，以及「安全邊際」]{#ANAKIN-147.xhtml#_idTextSpan3708
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:758.52px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[（判斷買進的時機）]{#ANAKIN-147.xhtml#_idTextSpan3709
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:1388px;left:2844.45px;letter-spacing:13.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[。]{#ANAKIN-147.xhtml#_idTextSpan3710
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:4551.12px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[許多人會把停損和停利誤用到「投資」上，這是一個嚴重的錯誤。]{#ANAKIN-147.xhtml#_idTextSpan3711
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:13.37px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[如果巴菲特有在做停利，那麼他就不會是今天的股神，你可以自行上]{#ANAKIN-147.xhtml#_idTextSpan3712
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[網搜尋「巴菲特＋停利」，就可以發現找不到相關訊息。至於停損，道]{#ANAKIN-147.xhtml#_idTextSpan3713
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[理亦同。]{#ANAKIN-147.xhtml#_idTextSpan3714
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[並不是說「投資」就不能停損或停利，而是投資領域的精髓在於]{#ANAKIN-147.xhtml#_idTextSpan3715
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[「判斷公司的股價與合理價值之間的差異有多大」，如果股價已經超過]{#ANAKIN-147.xhtml#_idTextSpan3716
.CharOverride-24

[而一國的大盤指數，較難被少數人操控。]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4005
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[此外，大盤指數整體而言的流動性比個股好得太多，也因此較]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4006
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:30.65px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[能夠實際反映出投資人真實的想法和情緒，個股有時候礙於流動性不]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4007
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[足，有時候不是反映不足、不然就是反映太過。大盤指數的奧妙之]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4008
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:29.92px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[處，就是在於其「自然的淘汰機制」，贏者生存、弱者被淘汰。]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4009
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[臺灣加權股價指數的編制，是以發行量加權的，而個股占指數的]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4010
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[權重，就會等於「發行量乘以股價」，再除以「整體所有上市公司發行]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4011
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[量，乘以股價的加總」，所得到的比重。而「發行量乘以股價」就是市值，]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4012
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:-0.6px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[「整體所有上市公司發行量，乘以股價的加總」就是上市公司總市值。]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4013
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:8.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[舉例來說，像台積電這樣的好公司，一則因為股價持續上漲、]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4014
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:30.65px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[二則因為公司每年獲利穩定而能夠持續配股，或增資發行新股，如此]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4015
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[就會造成它的市值不斷地膨脹，而台積電占大盤指數的權重，就會變]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4016
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[高。相反的，倘若一家原本上市的公司因為被淘汰而下市，就會消失]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4017
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.48px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[在指數成分當中，而且不用等到下市，只要公司競爭力衰退導致股價下]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4018
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.69px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[滑，那麼它的市值就會同時下滑，而它占大盤指數的權重就會下降。]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4019
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.2px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[如果你要分析預測的個股，是占指數權重較高的個股，那麼在使]{#ANAKIN-161.xhtml#_idTextSpan4020
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8664px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[較能夠和大盤指數彼此相互參照，不太容易發生「看對大盤但賠了股]{#ANAKIN-162.xhtml#_idTextSpan4025
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[價」這種令人扼腕的狀況。但若你要預測的是市值很小的中小型公司股]{#ANAKIN-162.xhtml#_idTextSpan4026
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[價漲跌，那麼通常技術分析對你的幫助就會較小，反倒是基本分析或]{#ANAKIN-162.xhtml#_idTextSpan4027
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[消息面、籌碼面的影響就會很大。]{#ANAKIN-162.xhtml#_idTextSpan4028
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:13.25px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[而容易落入「主力控盤者」刻意對該個股做出線型讓你跳進去的陷阱。]{#ANAKIN-162.xhtml#_idTextSpan4030

style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.2px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的預測，被事後驗證為準確的機率高達8成，然而，往往我提出一個新]{#ANAKIN-162.xhtml#_idTextSpan4035
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:0px;letter-spacing:17.35px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[預測的當下，看到的人若是新朋友，當下以不相信的居多。]{#ANAKIN-162.xhtml#_idTextSpan4036
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[為什麼多數人無法接受「金融市場通常可以被預測」這件事呢？]{#ANAKIN-162.xhtml#_idTextSpan4037
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[因為成見，也因為事實不斷證明：市場上人們的預測常常出現錯誤。]{#ANAKIN-162.xhtml#_idTextSpan4038
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[但是，並不能說「因為多數人做不到，所以代表這件事不可能」，因為]{#ANAKIN-162.xhtml#_idTextSpan4039

style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:20.24px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[歐元與日圓維持弱勢，而歐股與日股持續上漲的趨勢就會繼續下去，]{#ANAKIN-195.xhtml#_idTextSpan4869

style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[是指在這一波大趨勢的方向上來看是如此，不代表「短期一定成立」。]{#ANAKIN-195.xhtml#_idTextSpan4873

style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[多元聯立方程式，一組最能夠同時解釋股市、外匯、債券、利率、商]{#ANAKIN-197.xhtml#_idTextSpan4927
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[品，以及原物料變化的「最合理解」，就可以視為是「最佳解」，而它也]{#ANAKIN-197.xhtml#_idTextSpan4928
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:0px;letter-spacing:6.49px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[將是最可能被實現的一個預測。因為這個最佳解同時符合了金融市場]{#ANAKIN-197.xhtml#_idTextSpan4929
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的種種現實狀況，也因為貼近現實，所以這樣的一個預測會比其他較]{#ANAKIN-197.xhtml#_idTextSpan4930
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[不符合現實的預測更容易被實現。]{#ANAKIN-197.xhtml#_idTextSpan4931
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[以上我用數學的多元聯立方程式的概念來解說，是有助於你去理]{#ANAKIN-197.xhtml#_idTextSpan4932
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[解整個立體的國際金融市場的樣貌，以及彼此關聯性的運作過程，但]{#ANAKIN-197.xhtml#_idTextSpan4933
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[不代表實務上真的可以這樣去解它，實際上也沒有人去解開它。全世]{#ANAKIN-197.xhtml#_idTextSpan4934
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8208px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[界有上萬種金融商品，哪有可能一次解開呢？放心吧，你不需要真正]{#ANAKIN-197.xhtml#_idTextSpan4935
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8664px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[在全球股市「大空頭」的洗禮真正來臨之前]{#ANAKIN-213.xhtml#_idTextSpan5245
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:8.02px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[（這裡指的大空頭，是指全世]{#ANAKIN-213.xhtml#_idTextSpan5246
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:932px;left:4716.26px;letter-spacing:7.09px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[界股市平均跌幅超過50％以上，在2000年至2003年期間發生過一次，主因是科技泡]{#ANAKIN-213.xhtml#_idTextSpan5247
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:18.65px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[沫；2007年至2008年再發生一次，主因是美國房貸泡沫釀成全球金融海嘯）]{#ANAKIN-213.xhtml#_idTextSpan5248
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:1844px;left:0px;letter-spacing:15.83px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[，你一]{#ANAKIN-213.xhtml#_idTextSpan5249
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:6395.36px;letter-spacing:20.62px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[定要建立正確的心法、閱讀經得起大空頭考驗的大師經典書籍，而不]{#ANAKIN-213.xhtml#_idTextSpan5250
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[要浪費太多時間在枝微末節的技巧上。因為，當海嘯來襲時，能夠讓]{#ANAKIN-213.xhtml#_idTextSpan5251
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[你全身而退的是「你不在海裡」，而不是你的游泳技巧有多好。每個人]{#ANAKIN-213.xhtml#_idTextSpan5252
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[都有貪婪和恐懼，但每個人有各自不同要面對的難題，自己的心魔要]{#ANAKIN-213.xhtml#_idTextSpan5253
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[自己戰勝，在大空頭市場中，只有你自己能夠拯救自己。]{#ANAKIN-213.xhtml#_idTextSpan5254
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:3.3px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:25.08px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[不如前面歷史上的3次大空頭、指數與年線或10年線的正乖離也不算]{#ANAKIN-231.xhtml#_idTextSpan5742
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:24.44px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[很大，也因此，造成的跌幅僅有28.1％。]{#ANAKIN-231.xhtml#_idTextSpan5743
.CharOverride-24

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:23.92px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[更小、指數正乖離狀況也不明顯，因此，倘若台股真要從目前這個狀]{#ANAKIN-231.xhtml#_idTextSpan5745
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[況下起跌，老實說，跌不到太深。因為多空是相生的，貪婪有多大、]{#ANAKIN-231.xhtml#_idTextSpan5746
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[未來的恐懼就有多大。現在台股投資人普遍戒慎恐懼、做空、避險、]{#ANAKIN-231.xhtml#_idTextSpan5747
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[空手的人不少，要跌，不容易跌深。]{#ANAKIN-231.xhtml#_idTextSpan5748
.CharOverride-24

::: {style="width:7086.61px;height:8900.79px;position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 0%; -webkit-transform: translate(0px,4.3px) rotate(0deg) scale(0.05);transform-origin: 0% 0%; transform: translate(0px,4.3px) rotate(0deg) scale(0.05);"}
[趨勢中，而多頭的結束，就要透過對景氣循環、利率循環，以及市場]{#ANAKIN-244.xhtml#_idTextSpan6147
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[上投資人的樂觀程度來做觀察，才能判斷。對於股市高點預設立場，]{#ANAKIN-244.xhtml#_idTextSpan6148
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[通常是不智的，因為當股市頻創新高，多數投資人都在歡慶大賺的同]{#ANAKIN-244.xhtml#_idTextSpan6149
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[時，你無法參與他們的快樂，甚至因為放空虧損而難過。過去2年市場]{#ANAKIN-244.xhtml#_idTextSpan6150
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:17.35px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[上不斷有人在看空、做空，然而這2年下來多半是徒勞無功。]{#ANAKIN-244.xhtml#_idTextSpan6151
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[然而，股市多頭總有其盡頭，因為多空是相生的，只有多頭而沒]{#ANAKIN-244.xhtml#_idTextSpan6152
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[有空頭的市場，反而是一個虛假的市場、一個騙局。我無意看空全球]{#ANAKIN-244.xhtml#_idTextSpan6153
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[股市，我也不打算預設立場說高點在哪裡，而是要提醒你：按照本章]{#ANAKIN-244.xhtml#_idTextSpan6154
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[之前所觀察的方法，去多留意市場風向轉變的訊號，倘若股市多頭行]{#ANAKIN-244.xhtml#_idTextSpan6155
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[情真的在一片歡欣鼓舞當中幻滅時，你會因為做過逃生訓練，知道哪]{#ANAKIN-244.xhtml#_idTextSpan6156
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[些是正確的逃生方法、第一時間在大家仍錯愕時，你已經迅速抵達安]{#ANAKIN-244.xhtml#_idTextSpan6157
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[全的地方。]{#ANAKIN-244.xhtml#_idTextSpan6158
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[面對自2009年以來的全球股市大多頭，倘若走到2017年底，就是]{#ANAKIN-244.xhtml#_idTextSpan6159
.CharOverride-24

.羅馬字縮緊 .CharOverride-24

[S&P500指數自2009年3月6日起漲來算的話，9年又5個月就是2018]{#ANAKIN-245.xhtml#_idTextSpan6177
.羅馬字縮緊 .CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:0px;left:0px;letter-spacing:29.1px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[年8月，將挑戰歷史最長多頭紀錄！]{#ANAKIN-245.xhtml#_idTextSpan6178
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:15.81px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[以景氣循環的週期來看，自2009年第2季經濟基本面落底、開始]{#ANAKIN-245.xhtml#_idTextSpan6179
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:23.92px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[擴張以來，景氣高峰出現在2018年至2020年之間的機率是高的，倘]{#ANAKIN-245.xhtml#_idTextSpan6180
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:26.3px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[若2017年就因為股市過度樂觀而暴漲，快的話，說不定2017年下半年]{#ANAKIN-245.xhtml#_idTextSpan6181
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:19.05px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[的股市就會提早見到高點，而後景氣持續擴張，只是股市持續在高檔]{#ANAKIN-245.xhtml#_idTextSpan6182
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[盤旋，無法再創新高，直到景氣出現走緩跡象時，股價就會快速的下]{#ANAKIN-245.xhtml#_idTextSpan6183
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[滑，投資人這才會赫然發現：原來股價的高點已過了。]{#ANAKIN-245.xhtml#_idTextSpan6184
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[由於這個跡象或早或晚，可能在未來這幾年內會見到，因此我建]{#ANAKIN-245.xhtml#_idTextSpan6185
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[議在做投資配置時，除了股票之外，可以納入一部分的債券，而且隨]{#ANAKIN-245.xhtml#_idTextSpan6186
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[著利率攀升到愈高，你要買的債券佔總資產的比重就要愈多。]{#ANAKIN-245.xhtml#_idTextSpan6187
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[美國政府公債]{#ANAKIN-247.xhtml#_idTextSpan6224 .CharOverride-31
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:480px;letter-spacing:18.75px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 200.20px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 200.20px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[當景氣衰退時，美國聯準會通常會進行降息來刺激經濟，尤其以]{#ANAKIN-247.xhtml#_idTextSpan6225
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[目前全世界主要的成熟國家，如歐元區、日本，都還在負利率的狀態]{#ANAKIN-247.xhtml#_idTextSpan6226
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[下，現階段最有空間和條件可以進行降息的大國，就是美國了。並不]{#ANAKIN-247.xhtml#_idTextSpan6227
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[是說歐元區或日本不能降息，畢竟負利率還可以降到「負更大」，只是]{#ANAKIN-247.xhtml#_idTextSpan6228
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[相對而言，光憑降息幅度空間大小來比，美國算是較大的。]{#ANAKIN-247.xhtml#_idTextSpan6229
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[由於「公債價格」與「利率」呈現反向關係，因此，未來美國聯準會]{#ANAKIN-247.xhtml#_idTextSpan6230
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:5.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[進行降息時，最直接受惠的就是美國政府公債。若要直接購買美國政]{#ANAKIN-247.xhtml#_idTextSpan6231
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[府公債，需要不小的金額門檻，然而現在台灣就可以買得到「美國長天]{#ANAKIN-247.xhtml#_idTextSpan6232
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[期公債指數的ETF」，只要新臺幣幾萬元就可以買進、在集中市場交]{#ANAKIN-247.xhtml#_idTextSpan6233
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:24.44px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[易，這是不錯的選擇。不過畢竟美債ETF是投資在美元計價的債券，]{#ANAKIN-247.xhtml#_idTextSpan6234
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5928px;left:0px;letter-spacing:24.44px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[而換算成新臺幣計價在臺灣證交所掛牌，因此新臺幣兌美元之間的匯]{#ANAKIN-247.xhtml#_idTextSpan6235
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[率波動，將影響這類ETF的淨值波動，這是難以避免的。]{#ANAKIN-247.xhtml#_idTextSpan6236
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:6840px;left:0px;letter-spacing:15.23px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[保本基金]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6242 .CharOverride-31
style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:480px;letter-spacing:18.75px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 200.20px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 200.20px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[千萬不要在利率低檔時買進保本基金，例如2009年，全世界處於]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6243
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:20.25px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[低利率的環境下，此時若買進保本基金，只能「保住本」，而美股2009]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6244
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:12.63px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[年至2016年的漲幅超過250％]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6245
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:11.66px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[（若將配息還原的話）]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6246
.內文-括弧內文字 .CharOverride-30
style="position:absolute;top:2300px;left:2877.75px;letter-spacing:14.04px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 144.14px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[，你會因此變成財富重]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6247
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:4779.31px;letter-spacing:17.09px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[分配的輸家、且是有保證的輸家！]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6248
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2736px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[反過來說，你應該要在利率高檔時，買進保本基金，因為保住的]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6249
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[不僅是本，還加上每年鎖定住的高利率。當景氣反轉向下時，股票或]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6250
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[其他風險性資產損傷慘重時，你不僅保住本還加上利息的收益，你就]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6251
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[會變成財富重分配的大贏家。]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6252
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[標的 ]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6253 .CharOverride-6
style="position:absolute;top:6102.33px;left:484.56px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 160.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 160.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[3]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6254
.CharOverride-6
style="position:absolute;top:6102.33px;left:974.56px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 160.16px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 160.16px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[銀行定存]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6255 .CharOverride-31
style="position:absolute;top:6384px;left:480px;letter-spacing:18.75px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 200.20px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 200.20px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[定存的意思和保本基金一樣，只是它的利率可能會比保本基金還]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6256
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7296px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[要低一些。活儲就遠不如定存，因為定存不僅是利率高於活儲，而且]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6257
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:7752px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[因為有鎖定期間，會幫助你有紀律的靜下心來等待景氣的復甦，而不]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6258
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8208px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[像活儲的錢可能動不動就被你拿去亂投資、或者被詐騙。]{#ANAKIN-248.xhtml#_idTextSpan6259
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:8664px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

style="position:absolute;top:456px;left:0px;letter-spacing:20.24px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[期間，不少中小型銀行被合併或收購，有時候會因此造成擠兌潮，就]{#ANAKIN-249.xhtml#_idTextSpan6268

.CharOverride-24

.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:912px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[終點，就是多頭的起點。周而復始，除非人性被磨滅了，否則這個盛]{#ANAKIN-260.xhtml#_idTextSpan6517
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1368px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[衰循環就會永遠存在。華爾街的諺語告訴我們：「陽光下沒有新鮮事，]{#ANAKIN-260.xhtml#_idTextSpan6518
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:1824px;left:0px;letter-spacing:13.8px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[過去發生的，未來還是會繼續再發生。」]{#ANAKIN-260.xhtml#_idTextSpan6519
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:2280px;left:0px;letter-spacing:16.5px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}

[這就是我和其他高手們獲利的核心之道，如果有一天你也通透了]{#ANAKIN-260.xhtml#_idTextSpan6520
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3192px;left:470.55px;letter-spacing:21.7px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[這個道理，那麼恭喜你、也歡迎你加入高手的行列，並且期待你把這]{#ANAKIN-260.xhtml#_idTextSpan6521
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:3648px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[些股市的道理傳遞下去，因為在你傳遞智慧的過程中，最大的受惠者]{#ANAKIN-260.xhtml#_idTextSpan6522
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4104px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[還是你自己。在這條高手的養成之路上，不是0與1的遊戲，而是從0]{#ANAKIN-260.xhtml#_idTextSpan6523
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:4560px;left:0px;letter-spacing:24.09px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[到無限大的累積，我不知道你何時可以讓自己的能力累積到無限大，]{#ANAKIN-260.xhtml#_idTextSpan6524
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5016px;left:0px;letter-spacing:21.59px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[但我確定的是，你會走到離0很遠很遠的距離，當你回頭看看以前的自]{#ANAKIN-260.xhtml#_idTextSpan6525
.CharOverride-24
style="position:absolute;top:5472px;left:0px;letter-spacing:17.35px;-webkit-transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;-webkit-transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);transform-origin: 0% 176.17px;transform:matrix(0.98,0,0,1,0,0);"}[己，你會發現：自己已經站在一個從未想像過的遙遠距離。]{#ANAKIN-260.xhtml#_idTextSpan6526
